citazioni: To analyse the system further, thermal analyses (TG/DTA) of 1a and 1b were performed (Fig. S5 and S6†), which indicated a phase transition taking place in the case of 1a at ca. 100 °C.
All TGA experiments were performed at a heating rate of 2 °C min−1 under dry nitrogen with a flow rate of 100 ml min−1 covering the temperature range: 25–600 °C.
Upon heating, these phases transform into a more stable form, whereby the transformations were followed by PXRD studies (1, 2).

Moreover, we could also pinpoint solvents in which the metastable form was predominantly present, namely THF and EtOH, respectively, and follow the irreversible transformations of the isolated metastable forms to the stable arrangement upon heating.

citazioni: A PXRD study revealed that after heating this sample at 150 °C for 3 min, the monohydrate is completely converted to 2b, whereas the 2c phase is only partially converted.

Furthermore, not only the transformation of a metastable to a stable phase of different molecular packing was observed, but also the dehydration of monohydrate 2, transforming to the energetically favoured phase 2b of similar packing.
Interestingly, comparing the molecular packings formed by monohydrated 2H and 2b indicates the presence of the same main packing features, which could facilitate the dehydration/hydration process.

citazioni: The compounds 1 and 2 were recrystallized from a range of solvents of different geometry and polarity, such as acetone, acetonitrile, DCM, EtOH, MeOH and THF (10 mg of compound/10 ml of solvent). Vials covered with parafilm were left to undergo slow evaporation, which allowed us to obtain good quality crystals in all vials containing 1.

We isolated single-crystals from this solvent, collected SCXRD data, determined the crystal structure (1a) and generated its powder pattern, which corresponded very well with the experimentally determined trace (Fig. 1).
Moreover, the phase 1b shows its dominance in all studied solids, apart from the one obtained from THF, in which its contribution is negligible, at ca. 2%.
